item.title: G20 family photo cancelled after European allies refuse to appear with Russia's Lavrov
item.description: The traditional “family photo” to open the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting was abruptly cancelled on Friday in Atlanta after a host of nations—including Australia, the UK, and several European countries—refused to appear beside Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov. item.title: Warriors rally from 25-point deficit to rout Lakers; Curry drops 31 in NBA Cup win
item.description: The Golden State Warriors erased a 25-point first-half deficit Friday night to defeat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-95 at Chase Center, improving to 3-3 after an 0-3 start.
